{{Top|leg}}
'''''Trawler''''' was a pair of civilian [[Modular conveyor]]s that were carrying [[Foodstuff/Legends|Foodstuffs]] to an unknown destination. The ships were inspected by a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] to find nothing of concern and the conveyors were allowed to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] without incident.
